features.title: Expose LicoUp local subordinate agents as a Codex plugin
acceptance: The repository contains one valid lico-up-codex marketplace package at 0.1.0 and removes the retired LicoArc compatibility plugin.
The plugin launches the installed LicoUp companion runtime through the public Subagent MCP contract and exposes list, probe, delegate, continue, and cancel tools in a real MCP handshake.

Focused tests, catalog consistency, repository privacy scanning, version governance, and the independent release audit pass without publishing local paths, credentials, account data, or conversation content.
evidence: Focused verification passed: manifest validation, four runtime tests, five-tool MCP handshake, catalog consistency, and repository privacy workflow.
